meta_description: Leo Vann Heating in Coventry offers emergency plumbing, boiler repairs, and heating installations. Fast response, local service. Call now for urgent help.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe, broken boiler, or frozen tap in Coventry? We arrive within the hour, any time of day or night.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Coventry
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to planned installations, we handle every plumbing and heating job with speed and care.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Callouts
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, overflowing toilets — we're on the road within an hour, any time of day. Diagnosis and repair happen fast; we carry most parts on the van.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Annual boiler servicing keeps your heating running safely and efficiently. If it breaks down, we diagnose and fix faults same day, and all work carries a 12-month parts warranty.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: New system installed, old radiators replaced, or pipework upgraded. We design and fit heating to suit your home and budget, with long-term efficiency in mind.

services.title: Radiator Installation & Repair
services.desc: Cold spots on radiators, leaks, or noisy pipes — we balance systems, bleed air, and replace damaged units. Quick turnaround, minimal disruption.

services.title: Tap & Bathroom Repairs
services.desc: Dripping taps, broken shower valves, or stuck stopcocks — we fix leaks before they waste money and cause water damage. Most repairs completed in one visit.

services.title: Power Flushing & System Cleaning
services.desc: Sludge and debris in your heating pipes reduce efficiency and cause breakdowns. Power flushing clears the system, improves heat distribution, and extends boiler life.

about_pullquote: I started this business to give Coventry honest, fair-priced emergency plumbing when people need it most.
about_para_1: Leo Vann Heating has been serving Coventry homes and businesses for 12 years. We began as a one-man operation and have grown to a trusted local team, handling hundreds of emergency callouts and planned installations every year. We're Gas Safe Registered and operate around the clock to catch the problems that can't wait.
about_para_2: Customers come back because we answer the phone, we turn up on time, and we fix the job properly first time. We don't overcharge for emergencies — our rates are fair whether it's midnight or Monday morning. That reputation has made us one of Coventry's busiest plumbers, and we're proud of it.
reviews_heading: What Coventry Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Boiler went out on a Saturday night in December — thought we were done for. Leo answered the phone within two minutes and was at our house by 9:30pm. Diagnosed a faulty valve, replaced it, and we had hot water again before bed. Saved us from a miserable weekend. Can't fault him.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had a leak under the kitchen sink that was getting worse. Called Monday morning and they came out Tuesday morning. Plumber was really thorough, replaced the trap, checked all the joints, and left the area clean. Fair price too — no surprise invoices. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Margaret P.

reviews.text: We've used Leo for three jobs now — boiler service, radiator repairs, and a tap replacement. Every time, professional, punctual, and they explain what they're doing. Leo's honest about what needs doing and doesn't push you into unnecessary work. That's rare. Will keep using them.
reviews.author: James K.
